$comment: Approved production Windows native-preview runtime plan. This is a contract and single source of truth for a future Windows build, not a release payload. A Windows-runner build must realize this plan and pass exact-SHA CI before release.yml may ship a product Windows build; until then the release variant stays minimal.

ffmpeg.note: Reuse the signature-verified FFmpeg 8.1.3 source pin defined there (url, sha256, signature_url, key_url, fingerprint, avcodec_version 62.28.103, required_decoders). The pin is deliberately not duplicated here; the offline contract checks the reference resolves to the approved release.

vcpkg.constraint: This baseline's ffmpeg port builds 9.0.2, not the approved 8.1.3. A production build must override the port source to the approved signature-verified 8.1.3 tarball and adapt only patches justified from exact pinned-source contexts. It must not use an unsigned git commit or an unsigned Rust binding override.

bindings.note: Stock crates.io versions from Cargo.lock, whose ffmpeg-sys-next 9.0.1 declares the ffmpeg_8_1 (62.28) ABI matching 8.1.3. No git or path override.

binding_abi.note: Checked-in copy of the ffmpeg_8_1 ABI tuple declared by the locked ffmpeg-sys-next build.rs. Recorded here so the semantic tie to the approved source (avcodec_version 62.28.103) is asserted in CI without a crate source cache; the build.rs bytes are additionally checked when the cache is present.

pdfium.note: Same approved chromium/8138 bblanchon release family as the Linux PDFium pin. Windows production staging must verify size, sha256 and release attestation, mirroring the Linux contract, before the runtime may ship.
